time_axis.timestamp_semantics: camera deployment timestamps are interpreted in Asia/Tokyo when source values are timezone-naive; explicit offsets are converted to Asia/Tokyo
time_axis.array_anchor: minimum deployment start timestamp within each frozen subproject_name array, without rounding
time_axis.supplementary_relative_weeks: 11+ if response-independently eligible; never changes the primary decision

geometry.weighted_within_array_lcc_fraction: sum over arrays of the largest connected component node count at the threshold, divided by 90 frozen deployments
geometry.threshold_rule: for each target choose the smallest observed positive within-array pairwise distance whose weighted within-array LCC fraction reaches the target

future_endpoint_if_gate1_passes: For each response-independently eligible deployment campaign-week from relative week 2 onward, predict whether at least one Cervus nippon sequence is recorded during that site-week, using only information available before that site's current week outcome.
